The *Katādhikārasaphalapañha* ("The Question on Honors Paid To the Buddha", Mil 5.1.1) is a section of the *Milindapañha* [Catalog; SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records four translations across three languages, including an English translation by John Kelly [SuttaCentral]. The text connects thematically or intertextually with the *Mahāparinibbāna Sutta* (DN 16), the *Yakkhapahāra Sutta* (Ud 4.4), and a subsequent section of the *Milindapañha*, the *Khuddānukhuddakapañha* (Mil 5.2.1) [SuttaCentral].
Text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus identifies 438 matching passages shared between the *Katādhikārasaphalapañha* and 26 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most extensive reuse occurs internally within the *Milindapañha*, showing substantial parallels with the *Vessantarapañha* (Mil 6.3.1, including §7.8_3–8.1 matching §27.1), the *Devadattapabbajjapañha* (Mil 5.1.3), the *Akālamaraṇapañha* (Mil 6.3.6), and the *Udakasattajīvapañha* (Mil 6.1.9) [DharmaNexus]. It also shares passages with several commentary collections, including the *Ekakanipāta-aṭṭhakathā* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya*, the *Pāthikavaggaṭṭhakathā* of the *Dīgha Nikāya*, and the *Uparipaṇṇāsa-aṭṭhakathā* of the *Majjhima Nikāya* [DharmaNexus]. Cross-tradition machine alignment in DharmaNexus reports low-level matches with the Chinese translation *Dà zhèngjù wáng jīng* (大正句王經, T 45) [DharmaNexus].
